lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively wider in the anterior-to-midsection and compresses slightly as the lines approach the posterior mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th, 11th, and 12th vertical lines (counting from anterior to posterior) exhibit discontinuities, breaking into isolated spots or dashes in the mid-to-lower quadrant of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High density cluster of 8-10 white spots on the lateral haunch and proximal hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible on the upper posterior thigh, approximately parallel to the horizontal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white spot on the cheek/lower jaw area; white transverse band on the lower neck; white patches above the hooves; dark dorsal fringe of hair along the spinal ridge.
